properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.3 (SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations) is declared in contracts/100/yarn.lock, pulled via elliptic/ethers dependency chains. The library ships SHA-1 among its hashes; no first-party call site observed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: crypto-js@3.3.0, which provides MD5 among its algorithms, is declared in contracts/100/yarn.lock and contracts/102/package-lock.json. The weak digest ships with the build; no first-party MD5 call site observed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 — the Ethereum signature curve — is declared via the secp256k1 and @noble/secp256k1 npm packages in the lockfiles of these DeFi projects (pulled in by ethers/ganache) and appears in solc compiler-input deployment artifacts. Every wallet signature on these chains is ECDSA-secp256k1: quantum-vulnerable under Shor, migration ML-DSA-65 — but the curve is fixed by the Ethereum protocol, not by this repo; changeable only ecosystem-wide.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Amended whole-object context after full read of utils/keys.ts: the committed key material includes 32-byte hex deploy private keys (MAINNET/KOVAN/ROPSTEN_DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY — same literal reused, also duplicated byte-for-byte at contracts/61/utils/keys.ts), an Infura API token, an Etherscan API key (keys.ts:1), an echidna fuzzing deployer key, and ~2000 deterministic local-test account private keys in contracts/66/packages/contracts/hardhatAccountsList2k.js. Beyond the regex-matched sites, keys.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: the evp_bytestokey npm package (OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey — single-round MD5 KDF) is declared throughout the package-lock.json files of contracts/101 and contracts/102, pulled in via ganache-core/browserify dependency chains. The weak KDF ships with the build; no first-party call site observed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: the sites are declarations of bcrypt-pbkdf (OpenSSH bcrypt-PBKDF, pulled by tweetnacl/authenticated encryption chains inside ganache-core) in the contracts/101/102 lockfiles — not bcrypt password hashing in application code. Dependency inventory keeps them.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Math.random() (non-cryptographic PRNG) used as the randomness source for CREATE2-style deployment salts — sha256(Buffer.from('borrower' + Math.random() * 10000000)) — in sublime-v1 test templates, in test helpers (contracts/109), and for UI id/value generation in prepo frontends. Real weak-RNG posture in test/UI code; no key generation observed on these paths.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored crypto library surface: contracts/110 vendors OpenZeppelin's ECDSA library (utils/cryptography/ECDSA.sol) and its test suite — secp256k1 ECDSA signature recovery/verification over Ethereum, quantum-vulnerable under Shor (migration ML-DSA-65, though the Ethereum protocol fixes the curve). The library ships with these contracts whether or not the application's own code calls recover(); sites span the Solidity library, JS tests calling this.ecdsa.recover, and import-mapping scripts.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: ECDH key agreement is declared via the create-ecdh npm package (Node crypto.createECDH wrapper) in the contracts/101/102 lockfiles, pulled through ganache-core/browserify chains. No first-party ECDH call site observed; the capability ships with the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 (PQ-vulnerable signature scheme) generates the mock validator consensus keys in the gravity keeper test harness: ed25519.GenPrivKey() x5 in test_common.go. Tendermint/Cosmos consensus relies on Ed25519 in production; here it appears only in tests. Same scheme as the module's production validator set signing.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl@1.0.3, which implements Ed25519 signatures, is declared in contracts/100/yarn.lock (pulled by the ethers/web3 stack). The algorithm ships with the build; no first-party Ed25519 call site observed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl@1.0.3, which implements X25519 (crypto_box key agreement), is declared in contracts/100/yarn.lock. X25519 is quantum-vulnerable key agreement (Shor); no first-party call site observed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (SHA-3 family) is the hash backbone of the entire Ethereum corpus: Solidity keccak256, ethers solidityKeccak256, Merkle-tree leaf hashing, CREATE2 address derivation, and keccak256 npm deps pinned in every lockfile. SHA-3 resists Grover beyond practical reach (sqrt-speedup only), so this is posture-neutral; it is inventoried as the dominant hash in the dataset.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: PBKDF2 is declared via @ethersproject/pbkdf2 and the pbkdf2 npm package throughout the lockfiles of contracts/101/102 (ethers keystore-wallet encryption KDF, also pulled by ganache-core). No first-party call site observed; the KDF ships with the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt is declared via scrypt-js throughout the lockfiles (pulled by @ethersproject/json-wallets for Ethereum keystore wallet encryption, @metamask/eth-sig-util, and ganache-core). Memory-hard password KDF; no first-party call site observed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: AES is declared via crypto-js@3.3.0 in contracts/100/yarn.lock and contracts/115/core/yarn.lock, and via pycryptodome==3.10.1 in contracts/51/vesting/requirements.txt. AES-256 itself is not Shor-broken (Grover only halves key strength); the concern is mode choice at call sites, none observed in first-party code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: SHA-256 declared via @noble/hashes@1.1.2 in contracts/101/sublime-v1/package-lock.json (ethers stack) and via the sha2 crate in contracts/27/cosmos-gravity-bridge/orchestrator/Cargo.lock (Rust gravity orchestrator). Symmetric primitives: not Shor-vulnerable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: BLAKE3 declared via @noble/hashes@1.1.2 in contracts/101/sublime-v1/package-lock.json. Modern hash; not quantum-urgent.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: SHA-3 declared via @noble/hashes@1.1.2 in contracts/101/sublime-v1/package-lock.json (also provides keccak256 for Ethereum). Modern hash; not quantum-urgent.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (tweetnacl secretbox authenticated encryption) declared via tweetnacl@1.0.3 in contracts/100/yarn.lock. Symmetric AE; not Shor-vulnerable. No first-party call site observed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: JWT signing capability declared via jsonwebtoken@8.5.1 (contracts/103/yarn.lock), github.com/dgrijalva/jwt-go (contracts/27 cosmos-gravity-bridge module go.sum — the deprecated, unmaintained JWT library), and PyJWT==1.7.1 (contracts/51/vesting/requirements.txt). Default JWT algorithms are HMAC-based (HS256), but the libraries also offer quantum-vulnerable RS256/ES256; algorithm choice at live call sites would decide urgency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: the pbkdf2 KDF is declared via the pbkdf2 npm package@3.1.1 in contracts/100/yarn.lock and via the Rust pbkdf2 crate in contracts/27/cosmos-gravity-bridge/orchestrator/Cargo.lock.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CA trust bundle for the Python vesting project: certifi==2021.5.30 pinned in requirements.txt — the root store that decides which TLS peers requests/urllib3 will accept. Dated 2021 (roots added since then are missing). Same logical asset as the certifi library entry (LIB-0a1caea6).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenSSL bindings (openssl crate) pinned in the gravity-bridge Rust orchestrator's Cargo.lock — the TLS/crypto provider for its Ethereum node connections and general crypto. Same logical asset as the openssl library entry (LIB-84f9e41d).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: X.509 self-signed certificate generation declared via selfsigned@2.1.1 in contracts/190/prepo-monorepo/yarn.lock — generates self-signed certs/keys at runtime, typically for dev/test TLS endpoints. Certificates chain to RSA/ECDSA keys, which are the Shor-vulnerable part.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X.509 certificate handling available to the Parthenon (contracts/115) core JS toolchain via dependencies pinned in yarn.lock (node-forge ships X.509/pkcs12 handling). Dependency-inventory entry.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: golang.org/x/crypto (the extended Go cryptography library) is a direct dependency of the gravity module — provides sha3, chacha20, hkdf, ed25519, secp256k1-era primitives to the Cosmos SDK build. Same logical asset as the golang.org/x/crypto library entry (LIB-a2c61150).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: JWS (JSON Web Signature) declared via jws@3.2.2 in contracts/103/yarn.lock, pulled by the jsonwebtoken stack. Signing format whose alg header selects the actual signature algorithm.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: JWA (JSON Web Algorithms) declared via jwa@1.4.1 in contracts/103/yarn.lock — implements the JOSE signing/verification algorithm registry (HS256, RS256, ES256...) used by jws.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: DNSSEC-capable DNS stack (miekg/dns / x/crypto) declared in the gravity module's go.sum — DNSSEC verification capability present in the build (relevant to the module's dependencies, not directly invoked by gravity logic).

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: the md5 npm package@2.3.0 (a thin MD5 digest wrapper) is declared in contracts/102/package-lock.json. MD5 is collision-broken regardless of quantum computing; ships with the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
